title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Mint Tobacco Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elf Bar ElfLiq Mint Tobacco offers a smooth and refined blend of earthy Tobacco with a light, sweet hint of Mint. The rich, smoky notes of classic Tobacco provide a warm, robust, and familiar base, while the cool Mint adds a refreshing lift, creating a balanced flavour that is endlessly smooth and invigorating. Ideal for vapers who enjoy the deep, satisfying taste of Tobacco with a subtle cooling twist. Blended for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this 50/50 VG/PG nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Best suited for low-powered pod kits and starter vape devices, Mint Tobacco delivers a bold yet well-rounded vape with discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Elf Bar ElfLiq brings the most popular Elf Bar disposable flavours into a 10ml e-liquid format, providing a cost-effective and sustainable way to enjoy signature flavours.
